title: A Transformer Block as nn.Module
learning_objectives: Build a pre-norm transformer block from nn.MultiheadAttention, LayerNorm and an MLP
Apply a causal attention mask so positions cannot see the future
hints: Check `d_model % n_heads == 0` before creating the layers.
`T = x.shape[1]`; `mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(T, T, dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device), diagonal=1) if causal else None`.
Attention returns `(output, weights)`; add the output to x, then add the MLP of `norm2(x)`.

failure_feedback.advice: The mask is True above the diagonal: torch.triu(ones, diagonal=1).
Use pre-norm order, GELU and the attribute names norm1, self_attn, norm2, linear1, linear2.
The MLP hidden layer is 4 × d_model wide.
Raise ValueError when d_model is not divisible by n_heads.
